appliedAnchor.finding: The entity coordinate identifies Kistefos Træsliberi itself and is linked to Kulturminne ID 241111. It lies inside the preserved pulp-mill core rather than at a generic Kistefos information point.

officialIndustrialIdentity.finding: The official museum documents A/S Kistefos Træsliberi as founded in 1889, in production from 1890 to 1955, and preserved with buildings and production equipment nearly complete.

officialProductionCore.finding: The official museum identifies the old wood-pulp factory as the heart of Kistefos and describes the intact machinery and production rooms as the living industrial museum.

officialVisitorContext.finding: Kistefos publishes two access contexts for the museum area. These are used as visitor and access information, not as substitutes for the historic mill anchor.

heritageScope.finding: The protection includes the pulp mill, forge/workshop, boiler house, log-floating installations, saw-house ruin, gardens, former work areas, roads, water and green areas connecting the industrial complex.

industrialLandscapeContext.finding: Riksantikvaren describes a complex on the west side of Randselva with the factory building, support buildings, worker and management housing, and traces of cableway and log-hauling infrastructure.

independentPhysicalCrossCheck.finding: The geotagged photograph of the pulp mill, explicitly linked to monument number 241111, was taken approximately 47.9 metres from the applied anchor and provides an independent physical cross-check.

falseCandidates.finding: A Kistefos information point near the mill is not the historic factory object and is rejected as canonical.
A second generic Kistefos information point north of the mill is rejected because it does not represent the pulp-mill building or industrial core.

radiusDecision.finding: The retained radius covers the pulp mill, nearby support buildings, power and river context, and much of the central industrial-museum environment. It is not the legal protection polygon or the full Kistefos art and sculpture destination.

decision.representationLimit: The marker represents the historic pulp mill and industrial core. The wider protected industrial landscape and modern art destination remain contextual extents rather than one exact circular geometry.
